messages:
Priya: FYI customer (Acme Corp) sees a schema validation error when a tool returns structured output. They sent a request id: req_0x5f3a9b. Can eng help gather repro steps?
Ethan: Thanks — can you paste the original request payload + request headers? any logs? :eyes:
Priya: Pasting the curl they used (redacted API key) and the error we saw.
Priya: ```
curl -X POST 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -H 'X-Redwood-Request-Id: req_0x5f3a9b' 
  -d '{
    "model": "redwood/open-3b-v1.1",
    "input": "Please call the inventory tool",
    "tools": [{
      "name": "inventory_lookup",
      "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"results":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"qty":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["id","qty"]}}}},
      "call": {"args":{}}
    }]
  }'
```
Priya: Our platform returned:```
HTTP 400 Bad Request
{"error":"validation error","message":"schema validation failed for tool output: $.results missing or not array","request_id":"req_0x5f3a9b"}
```
ops-bot: Incident alert attached for req_0x5f3a9b (severity: low) — collected logs available at https://internal-logs/redwood/req_0x5f3a9b
Jin: Quick thought — are we sure the tool produced an array vs single object? we've seen serializers collapse singletons into objects before. Can you include the raw tool output from the debug bundle?
Marta: Also need region & deployment type from the customer. Dedicated vs hosted affects logging path.
Priya: Customer said Dedicated (us-west2), pinned model version, usage start ~2026-01-14T10:12:34Z. I uploaded their debug bundle: https://s3.redwood-internal/debug-bundles/req_0x5f3a9b.tgz (contains tool stdout/stderr, runtime traces, request headers)
Ethan: pulling logs now. Command I used: `redwood-cli fetch-logs --request req_0x5f3a9b --since 30m --service runtime`
Ethan: Log excerpt:```
[2026-01-14T10:12:34.512Z] runtime: tool-invoke inventory_lookup started req=req_0x5f3a9b
[2026-01-14T10:12:35.120Z] tool(inventory_lookup): stdout: {"results":{"id":"sku-123","qty":42}}
[2026-01-14T10:12:35.121Z] runtime: structured-output-validate failed: expected array at $.results
```
Jin: Bingo — tool returned an object `{"results": {"id":"..."}}` instead of `{"results": [{...}]}`. Our validator enforces array per schema.
Priya: Customer says their tool is a third-party microservice. They claim it returns a list normally, but maybe an optimization collapsed single-item lists.
Ethan: Two tracks: (1) engineering: consider relaxing validator to accept single-item object by coercing to array for backward-compatibility, (2) ops/support: get a minimal reproducible curl that elicits the object response so we can test locally.
Jin: I can prototype coercion in the runtime config but want to confirm no other callers rely on strict arrays. For now let's repro locally.
Marta: Priya — can you ask the customer to run this minimal repro curl (no API key needed if they run against their tool) and paste the response body? Also confirm Content-Type from their tool.
Priya: I'll ask them. Meanwhile Ethan, can you share a minimal curl I can run against our ingest to see validation path?
Ethan: Sure — use this against our staging validation endpoint (this will hit the same validator but not production):
Ethan: ```
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/validate-tool-output -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-Redwood-Request-Id: repro_local_0x01' -d '{"tool_name":"inventory_lookup","output": {"results": {"id":"sku-123","qty":42}} }'
```
Ethan: Expected response from validator: 400 + message about expecting array. If you change `"results": [{...}]` it should pass (200).
Priya: Running now against staging, will paste results.
Priya: Staging returns the same 400 and error: `expected array at $.results` — reproduced locally. :thumbsup:
Jin: Good repro. For next steps I propose: (A) short-term tolerance patch that wraps single object into array on validator layer, (B) follow-up with customer to fix tool serialization, (C) add a unit test to catch singleton-to-array cases.
Marta: Ops note — we should notify on the customer ticket we have a repro and give ETA for patch. Priya, any SLA constraints?
Priya: Customer is on enterprise support, needs a workaround in 2 business days. I'll update ticket with repro link + staging curl.
Ethan: I'll open a PR for the tolerance patch (small change in validator pipeline). Assigning to Jin for review. PR link will be posted here.
Jin: Reviewing once PR is up. Also suggest adding a runtime feature-flag: `validator.coerce_singleton_arrays = true` so we can roll it out carefully.
Priya: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up after customer confirms the tool-level test.
ops-bot: Uploaded debug bundle to internal retention bucket: s3://redwood-debug/req_0x5f3a9b.tgz (expires in 30 days)
Priya: Closing loop: customer confirmed their service had a JSON marshalling optimization in one language binding that emitted an object for singletons. They will patch. Keeping ticket open until our tolerance patch is merged. :white_check_mark:
